alerts.title: Free National Parks!
alerts.body: Canada Strong Pass covers your entire trip (July 11–17). Yoho, Banff, Revelstoke — all free. No Discovery Pass needed. You're saving ~$167.

alerts.title: Book Roam 8X Super Pass NOW
alerts.body: You need this for July 15 (Banff → Lake Louise → Moraine Lake). Book via roamtransit.com — sells out in summer!

alerts.title: Timezone Note
alerts.body: Vernon & Revelstoke = PDT (UTC−7). Golden, Banff, Yoho = MDT (UTC−6). Lose 1 hr Jul 12, gain it back Jul 16.

parkPass.title: 🎉 Parks Canada: Completely Free This Trip
parkPass.body: The Canada Strong Pass (June 19 – September 7, 2026) makes every Parks Canada site free. You save ~$167.50 (family rate). Only costs:
costs: Roam 8X Super Pass ~$30/adult for Day 5 shuttle (book roamtransit.com)
Parking at Banff Train Station: free 9 hrs

photo.alt: Vibrant turquoise waters of Kalamalka Lake near Vernon, BC

stops.title: Depart Langley
stops.desc: Head east on Highway 1. Pack the cooler, load up — adventure begins!

stops.title: Hope Stretch Break
stops.desc: Two solid options — pick based on how the babies are doing.

items.title: 🌊 Bridal Veil Falls PP
items.desc: Shaded picnic area with flush toilets. Fit adults + Ilyana walk to the falls (~20 min round trip) while LMC + babies relax at the tables.

items.title: 🌳 Memorial Park, Hope
items.desc: Downtown, flat grass, picnic tables, famous chainsaw carvings. 5 min off Hwy 1. Zero walking required.

stops.title: Merritt Lunch Stop
stops.desc: Pick up takeout in Merritt, then find a picnic spot. Rotary Park downtown is the smart call — splash pad for Ilyana, saves 50 min vs Monck Park detour.

items.title: 🍗 Mary Brown's Chicken
items.desc: Fried chicken. ⭐ 4.3

items.title: 🍛 Mughal Garden
items.desc: Butter chicken, biryani. ⭐ 4.5 — familiar food for the kids!

items.title: 🐟 Home Restaurant
items.desc: Diner, fish & chips. ⭐ 4.4

items.title: 🛝 Rotary Park, Merritt
items.desc: Splash pad, playground, picnic tables right downtown. Saves 50 min vs Monck Park detour. Ilyana will love the splash pad.

items.title: 🏞️ Nicola Lake — Monck Park
items.desc: Pebble beach, calm shallow water, paved picnic area. ~22 km from Merritt (+50 min round trip).

stops.title: Kelowna Waterfront Park
stops.desc: Paved lakeside boardwalk on Okanagan Lake. Public art, the famous Bear statue for Ilyana, public washrooms. Benches throughout.

stops.title: Check in — Silver Star Mountain, Vernon
stops.desc: Last 22 km up Silver Star Mountain Road climbs from ~400 m to ~1,600 m — steep, winding, ear-popping for babies. Have soothers or water ready. Drive carefully.

items.title: 🏖️ Kal Beach (Kalamalka Lake)
items.desc: 300 m sandy beach. Mobi-mats installed 2025 make the beach, pier, washrooms and concession fully accessible. South-facing — still warm evenings.
items.note: ~30 min drive down from Silver Star

items.title: 🌸 Polson Park, Vernon
items.desc: Downtown park, paved paths, Japanese garden, Veterans Walk. Good if everyone is wiped.

items.title: 🌊 Kalamalka Lake PP
items.desc: Postcard turquoise water — beautiful but beach access involves an uneven descent. Not recommended for LMC or strollers.

days.label: Day 2
days.stay: 🏠 Cedar House Chalets, Golden (735 Hefti Rd)

photo.alt: Trans-Canada Highway through the mountains, British Columbia

days.tzNote: ⏰ You'll cross into Mountain Time (MDT, UTC−6) near Revelstoke/Rogers Pass — your dashboard clock jumps forward 1 hour.

stops.title: Depart Silver Star — descend carefully
stops.desc: 8% grades on the descent. Take it slow, especially if it rained overnight.

stops.title: Sicamous — Quick Splash Stop
stops.desc: Sandy beach, flat access, splash park, playground, public washrooms right at the beach.

stops.title: Revelstoke Lunch — Centennial Park Picnic
stops.desc: Pick up takeout and eat at Centennial Park on the Columbia River — paved paths, picnic tables, fully accessible.

items.title: 🍺 Big Eddy Pub
items.desc: Fish & chips, opens 11 AM. ⭐ 4.6

items.title: 🥪 Terravita Kitchen
items.desc: Artisan sandwiches, opens 7 AM — great grab-and-go. ⭐ 4.7

items.title: 🍜 Sincero Cafe
items.desc: Vietnamese pho/banh mi ⭐ 4.5 — ⚠️ opens 1 PM Sundays. Skip on July 12!

stops.title: Optional Revelstoke Stop — Pick One Only

badges.text: ⚠️ Pick one — still 150 km of mountain driving to Golden

items.title: 🏗️ Revelstoke Dam Visitor Centre
items.desc: Elevator to the top of a 175 m hydro dam — genuinely unique! Fully wheelchair accessible, free admission, gift shop, washrooms. No bags inside (free lockers).
items.note: ⏰ You arrive at 2 PM PDT = 3 PM MDT (local). Last entry ~3:30 PM — just enough time!

items.title: 🏔️ Rogers Pass Discovery Centre
items.desc: ~70 km past Revelstoke. Avalanche history exhibits, washrooms, scenic viewpoint at 1,330 m. Free, ~20 min stop.

stops.title: Arrive Cedar House Chalets, Golden
stops.desc: ~7 hours total with stops. Babies will be wiped — plan a simple in-chalet dinner. Rest up for the big Yoho day tomorrow.

days.label: Day 3
days.route: Based in Golden · All times MDT

photo.alt: Emerald Lake, Yoho National Park, British Columbia

stops.title: Leave Golden
stops.desc: ~56 km to Emerald Lake, ~50 min drive. 🎉 Free national parks entry all day!

stops.title: Emerald Lake — Canoe + Lakeshore Walk
desc: One of the most stunning lakes in Canada. The left/west lakeshore path is ~1 km, paved and flat — perfect for strollers and LMC. Don't attempt the full 5.2 km perimeter (gets rough on the back side).
🛶 Canoe rental: Emerald Sports & Gifts, ~$110 CAD/hour. Life jackets including infant sizes — call ahead to confirm fit for ~9–10 month olds: 403-410-7417. Bring your own infant PFDs if possible!

stops.title: Natural Bridge
stops.desc: Fully paved viewing platform just ~50 m from parking. The Kicking Horse River carved through solid rock — wild to see! Zero hiking required.

stops.title: Lower Spiral Tunnels Viewpoint
stops.desc: Roadside pull-off, zero walking. ~25–30 CPKC freight trains pass daily — decent odds of catching one! (About every 50 min average.)

stops.title: Upper Spiral Tunnels Viewpoint
stops.desc: Second roadside viewpoint. Another chance to catch a train looping through the tunnels above and below itself.

badges.text: 2.3 km up Yoho Valley Rd · 15 min

stops.title: Takakkaw Falls
stops.desc: One of Canada's tallest waterfalls. Walk is 800 m one-way on paved concrete with wooden bridges. Three short sections at 8–12% grade (~70 m, 280 m, 550 m from trailhead) — jogging stroller handles easily, small umbrella strollers may struggle. Bring a light layer — mist at the base is cold even in July.
stops.note:
♿ LMC: if able to manage gentle inclines for 800 m with rest breaks, doable. Otherwise falls are visible from parking. One adult can stay closer to the car.
📸 Red Adirondack chairs near the base bridge = iconic Parks Canada photo op!

stops.title: Back in Golden
stops.desc: This is your best-balanced day. Enjoy dinner at the chalet — Icefields Parkway tomorrow is the longest driving day.

days.label: Day 4
days.route: Based in Golden · All times MDT · ~9 h day

photo.alt: Peyto Lake surrounded by mountains, Icefields Parkway, Canadian Rockies

stops.title: Fill Gas in Golden — Critical!
stops.desc: Don't skip this. Next reliable fuel is Saskatchewan Crossing, ~165 km away, and prices there are notoriously high.

badges.text: ⚠️ Next reliable fuel = Saskatchewan Crossing 165 km away

stops.title: Leave Golden — North on Hwy 93
stops.desc: The Icefields Parkway is one of the most beautiful drives in the world. Drive through Lake Louise gate area around 10:30 AM — no stopping needed there.

stops.title: Crowfoot Glacier Viewpoint
stops.desc: The glacier looks like a three-toed crow's foot (one toe has melted in recent years — a powerful reminder of climate change). Stunning from the parking lot, no walking needed.

stops.title: Bow Lake — Morning Reflection Stop
stops.desc: Best glacier-reflection morning view on the Parkway when the lake is calm. Free parking. ~100 m flat gravel to lakeshore. Num-Ti-Jah Lodge café for coffee/hot chocolate (check summer hours).
stops.note: Best light for photos is morning — this is the place to stretch the stop if babies are happy.

stops.title: Peyto Lake — 3rd Most-Visited Lake in Banff
stops.desc: The wolf-shaped turquoise lake at 2,070 m elevation. Absolutely stunning. Crowds are real — arrive with a plan.

badges.text: ⚠️ Two parking lots — strategy matters for LMC

stops.note: 🅿️ Upper lot (accessible/bus): Drop LMC + babies here — only ~80–100 m of flat paved walking to the viewing platform. 🅿️ Lower (main) lot: 400–700 m uphill paved path, ~70 m elevation gain, 10–15 min one-way. Challenging for LMC. ✅ Plan: Drop LMC + babies at upper lot, fit adults walk up from lower lot, reunite at the platform.

stops.title: Waterfowl Lakes Viewpoint
stops.desc: Beautiful twin lakes with mountain reflections. Fully accessible from the roadside pull-off — barely any walking needed.

stops.title: Mistaya Canyon
stops.desc: Stunning slot canyon carved by the Mistaya River. Packed dirt/gravel path, some rocky/rooty sections, uphill return. Wooden bridge with handrails over the canyon. Ilyana will love it — use a baby carrier.
stops.note: LMC stays in car or uses the small pullout area. The uphill return is the dealbreaker for limited mobility.

stops.title: Saskatchewan Crossing — Fuel + Washrooms + Food
stops.desc: The only services for ~165 km. Cafeteria is overpriced but functional. Fill up, use the washrooms (baby changing available), grab snacks for the return.

badges.text: ⚠️ Expensive fuel but fill up anyway for return

stops.note: 💡 Bail-out point: if babies are struggling, turn around here and head back — saves ~1 hour and the scenic highlights are already done.

stops.title: Turn Around → Back in Golden
stops.desc: Return drive through all the same scenery — different light, just as beautiful. Total day: ~9 hours. Babies will hopefully sleep on the return.

days.label: Day 5
days.date: Wednesday, 15 July — ⭐ Banff + Moraine + Lake Louise
days.route: Based in Golden · All times MDT · ~12 h door-to-door

photo.alt: Multicoloured canoes on the dock at Moraine Lake, Banff National Park

stops.title: Gas Up + Leave Golden
stops.desc: ~1 h 45 min drive to Banff. Park at Banff Train Station — 9 hours free parking (confirmed 2026).

badges.text: 🎟️ Roam 8X Super Pass confirmed? Board 20 min early at transit hub

stops.title: Bow Falls, Banff
stops.desc: Famous waterfall on the Bow River. Lower viewpoint is fully accessible — ~5 min walk from parking. Skip the upper viewpoint (stairs only).

stops.title: Vermilion Lakes Scenic Drive
stops.desc: Gorgeous wetland lakes with Mt Rundle reflection. Multiple pull-offs, you don't even need to get out. Watch for elk, beaver, and waterfowl.

badges.text: ♿ Perfect — entire view from the car

stops.title: Lunch in Banff
stops.desc: Use this time well — last comfortable baby feed + change before the shuttle.

badges.text: ⚠️ Last comfortable baby feed + change before the shuttle ordeal

items.title: 🍕 Bear Street Tavern
items.desc: Pizza, relaxed vibe, shareable plates. Great with kids.

items.title: 🍔 Eddie Burger Bar
items.desc: Quick, casual, good burgers. Easy to eat and go.

items.title: 🦞 Tooloulou's
items.desc: Cajun-Creole, shareable plates, kid-friendly.

items.title: 🥗 Balkan Restaurant
items.desc: Greek, hearty portions, good value.

stops.title: Walk to Banff High School Transit Hub
stops.desc: ~10 min walk from town centre. Look for the "8X Lake Louise" reservation lane (not the walk-up lane). Staff check tickets before boarding. Show up 20 min early!

badges.text: 🎟️ Have Super Pass tickets on phone or printed

stops.title: Board Roam 8X to Lake Louise — 54 min ride
stops.desc: Fold strollers for the luggage area. Use carriers on board. Babies may nap!

stops.title: Lake Louise Lakeshore — Brief Stop
stops.desc: Brief view of the iconic turquoise lake + Chateau Lake Louise. Then head to the green Parks Canada tents to collect Lake Connector boarding pass (free with Super Pass). Connector runs every ~30 min, first-come first-served.

stops.title: Moraine Lake — ~2.5 Hours
stops.desc: One of the most photographed lakes in the world — the famous Valley of the Ten Peaks backdrop with intense turquoise water. Afternoon crowds are genuinely thinner than morning. This is the right time slot. Flat lakeshore path is pram-friendly for ~300 m.

stops.title: HARD DEPARTURE — Board Lake Connector Back
stops.desc: If the queue is long, get in line by 4:50 PM at the latest. Your 5 PM departure gives a 1-hour buffer — wise, but don't push it.

badges.text: ⚠️ Last shuttle out is 6 PM — don't miss it!

stops.title: Lake Louise Lakeshore — Full Visit
stops.desc: Now you have time! Walk the flat paved path along the lake. Alpenglow building on Victoria Glacier — stunning golden-hour light. Go as far as comfortable.

stops.title: Roam 8X back to Banff → Drive to Golden
stops.desc: Arrive Banff ~6:54 PM, collect car, drive back to Golden (~1 h 45 min). Arrive ~8:45 PM. This is your longest day overall (~12 hours door-to-door). Bring extras of everything.

days.label: Day 6
days.route: ~283 km · GAIN 1 HOUR heading west into PDT

photo.alt: River surrounded by forest, British Columbia

days.tzNote: ⏰ You gain an hour crossing back into PDT. Leaving at 9:30 MDT = arriving Revelstoke ~11:30 PDT.

stops.title: Checkout Cedar House — Head West
stops.desc: ~150 km to Revelstoke, ~2 hours driving. You'll gain an hour as you cross the timezone boundary.

items.title: 🏗️ Revelstoke Dam
items.desc: Elevator to the top of the 175 m dam. Free, fully accessible, ~1 hr. No bags inside (free lockers).

items.title: 🌸 Meadows in the Sky
items.desc: Drive to 1,938 m in Mt. Revelstoke NP. ~1 km flat boardwalk loop at the top — fully stroller and wheelchair accessible. Mid-July wildflowers should be peaking!

items.title: ☕ Grizzly Plaza, Downtown
items.desc: Pedestrian street, cafés, easy stroll. Low-key rest-day vibe before Sorrento.

stops.title: En Route to Sorrento — Optional Stops
stops.desc: ~80 km from Revelstoke to Sorrento. Pick zero, one, or two based on energy levels.

items.title: 🌊 Three Valley Gap
items.desc: Scenic pull-off, photo stop only. ~20 km west of Revelstoke. 5 min, zero walking.

items.title: 🌉 Crazy Creek Suspension Bridges
items.desc: Paid stop. ~20 min boardwalk loop with suspension bridges. Mostly flat — bridges may be tricky for LMC. Worth it for Ilyana if you have an hour.

items.title: 🏛️ R.J. Haney Heritage Village
items.desc: Open-air museum in Salmon Arm, paved paths, café. Stroller and LMC friendly.

stops.title: Sorrento Evening — Shuswap Lake
stops.note: Skip Margaret Falls this evening — save it for tomorrow morning if you want it.

items.title: 🏖️ Sorrento Centre Private Beach
items.desc: Open 7 AM–dusk, calm Shuswap Lake water, picnic tables, portable washrooms.

items.title: 🏖️ Sandy Point Beach, Sorrento
items.desc: Small public beach, free, calm shallow water perfect for babies' feet.

photo.alt: Shuswap Lake with mountains, British Columbia

badges.text: ❌ Skip Johnson Lake — 1.5–2 h detour on 25+ km gravel FSR, no real beaches, not feasible with babies + LMC

items.title: 💦 Margaret Falls (Herald PP)
items.desc: ~30 km east of Sorrento. Pebble beach + lakeshore picnic for LMC + babies while others walk to the falls (30 min round trip). 500 m one-way, 57 m gain.

items.title: 🏖️ Shuswap Lake PP (Scotch Creek)
items.desc: ~40 km north shore. 1 km sand + pebble beach, adventure playground, designated swimming area. Pure relaxation pick.

items.title: 🚶 Salmon Arm Wharf
items.desc: North America's longest curved wooden inland wharf. Flat boardwalk, breakfast/coffee nearby. Quick 30–45 min stop.

stops.title: Kamloops — Riverside Park
stops.desc: South Thompson River park with marked swimming area, playground, splash park (lifeguards July 1–Aug 31), and paved paths throughout. Walking distance to downtown for lunch if you want.

stops.title: Merritt Lunch — Rotary Park
stops.desc: Same Rotary Park as Day 1 — splash pad for Ilyana while adults eat. Skip the Monck Park detour, you want to get home.

items.title: 🥗 Chloe's Diner
items.desc: ⭐ 4.8 — Tue–Sat. Friday July 17 ✅

items.title: 🧺 Valley Graze Box
items.desc: ⭐ 4.8 — opens 7 AM. Check Friday hours.

stops.title: Hope — Memorial Park
stops.desc: Flat park, chainsaw carvings, one last leg-stretch before home. Don't add Bridal Veil Falls — you're so close!

stops.title: Arrive Langley — Home! 🎉
stops.desc: The itinerary says 5 PM, but with two babies expect 5:30–6:00 PM. That's fine — build it into your expectations. What a trip! 🏔️

checklist.text: Infant PFDs (Type I, 9–15 kg) for Emerald Lake canoeing
Baby carriers — essential for Mistaya Canyon, Peyto, rough paths
Sun hats with neck protection for babies + adults
Mosquito netting for strollers (Bridal Veil + Yoho = bugs)
Cooler with frozen ice packs (restock at each stop)
Layers for babies (Takakkaw mist + Peyto at 2,070 m = cold)
Travel changing pad + lots of wipes
Bear spray (recommended for Mistaya, Yoho, and Banff stops)
Tylenol/Tempra infant drops (altitude + travel can spike fevers)
Canada Strong Pass screenshot/printout (just in case at a gate)
Jogging stroller (umbrella strollers struggle on some paths)
Cash for Saskatchewan Crossing (cards accepted but bring some)
